title: TV Ads on Demand: 5 Ways Catch-Up TV Is Changing the TV Advertising Game

facts.fact: The vendor states that nearly 2.5 million Australians choose BVOD over linear TV every week, citing unnamed 'recent statistics'.
facts.quote: recent statistics show that nearly 2.5M Australians choose BVOD over linear TV every week

facts.fact: The vendor says that 69% of consumers are more likely to engage with branded content than with traditional ads, citing unnamed research.
facts.quote: Research shows that 69% of consumers are more likely to engage with branded content than with traditional ads.

facts.fact: The vendor says brands are leaning into 10- to 15-second ad formats in Catch-up TV.
facts.quote: We’re talking about 10- to 15-second ads that get right to the point.

facts.fact: The vendor describes traditional TV prime time as running between 6 PM and 9 PM.
facts.quote: Advertisers would scramble to get their TV advertisements in front of viewers between 6 PM and 9 PM
